parsed.post: KEPT 0.8192 — huge win! DEPTH 8 + batch 262144 + WD 0.1 + LR 0.045 works beautifully, crushing the previous best. It seems the capacity gain from depth-8 is highly compatible with this hyperparameter stack within the 5-minute budget. Next: testing if lowering LR to 0.04 further stabilizes and improves this depth-8 config.
parsed.description: Refining the successful depth-8, batch 262144, WD 0.1 stack by lowering MATRIX_LR from 0.045 to 0.04 to see if slower learning improves convergence.
